answer: At dawn, an oasis economy could issue an earning permit only after its key burns a fixed amount. Validators bind the permit to that key and epoch, consume each burn output once, and reject reuse or attempts to forge permits. Every extra alias must destroy fresh value, even in a parallel colluding farm; set the burn above the maximum extra subsidy an alias can earn. This assumes final burn accounting and an enforceable reward ceiling. Newcomers can try a free sandbox, but must meet the same burn rule to earn; the entry cost excludes some honest users.
